text: Founded in 1958, the Specialty of Forestry, which recruits top university applicants, is a key specialty in Zhejiang province from 2002 and a national specialty from 2008, and is now listed among nationaltopspecialties. With the backup from such platforms as the State Key Laboratory of Subtropical Silviculture, National Joint Local Engineering Laboratory of Biopesticide High-Efficient Preparation, Academic Innovation and Intelligence Promotion Scheme(“111” Project), National Pilot Center for Experimental Teaching in Forestry, and National Field Base for College Students' Field Practice in the Tianmu Mountain, and a Provincially Top Discipline -- Forestry (Category A), the Specialty owns a teaching force composed of nationally outstanding youngsters, Yangtze River scholars, scholars listed in the national Millions of Talents Project, and a national teaching team, and hascomplete undergraduate, master and doctorate programs, has a national pilot project for reform in programs for nurturing top innovative talents in agriculture and forestry and a Sino-UBC (University of British Columbia) program approved by Ministry of Education.Based on the principles of lenient foundation, and pluralistic integration, this program of forestry professional education is for nurturing top innovative talents in modern forestry and natural resource protection and management.Thisprogram places more emphasis on firmly mastering the theory and skills of the core courses of the professional foundation; and the pluralistic integration emphasizes more on the interdisciplinary, the application of new science and technology, and the integration of the three industries; and adopts the new teaching modes and new form teaching materials, such as online and offline mixing and so on, to improve the teaching quality.This major develops political, economic and cultural knowledge of contemporary China and can participate in and promote friendly exchanges and cooperation between China andtheirhost countries.This major is mainly to practice the "two mountains theory", to meet the needs of national economic and social development in the new era, combining with the development requirements of the new forestry department, to cultivate modern forestry top-notch innovative talents and future leaders with good ecological civilization consciousness, international vision, innovative spirit and scientific literacy, autonomous learning, research and analysis ability and strong comprehensive competitiveness, and all around development of moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetics and labour education.
